description:
Implement every STATIC rule from docs/research/2026-09-30-german-style-catalog.md except de_binnen_i, which drops (decision Q20). That covers Floskeln, Füllwörter, Streckverben, Modalverb overuse, negation count, Schachtelsatz commas, long compounds, inflated diction, and the humanizer-de word patterns. Keep humanizer-de patterns and trigger words close to the original and credit them (decision Q13). Anglicisms follow humanizer-de (decision Q21). Each rule starts at observe and gets a German example pair as fixtures. Split into sub-tickets by rule group if one module passes five rules.

Acceptance.
1. Each rule has one violating and one clean German fixture.
2. Every rule starts at observe until T-010 measures it.
title: German STATIC rules, words and patterns
